senses.zh_definition: 邦妮／邦尼：人名 Bonnie 的音译；在马来语句中作为专有名词指称某人，具体中文译名随本人或既有译法确定。
senses.en_definition: Bonnie, a personal name used as a proper noun in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi seseorang, lazimnya ditulis Bonnie dengan huruf awal besar.
senses.nuances: 本条是人名的编辑性说明，并非 DBP 普通词释义。缺少原始语境，无法确定具体人物或排除作品、角色等专名用法。苏格兰语 bonnie 可表示漂亮，但不能把该义直接当作马来语形容词义。以下搭配为自然句法组合，没有高频统计依据。参见 [Bonnie 人名资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/bonnie)及 [苏格兰语词典 bonny／bonnie](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd00063617)。

etymology.historical_story: As a given name, Bonnie is associated with the Scots adjective bonnie, meaning pretty or attractive. In Malay discourse, however, the name identifies a person rather than describing someone's appearance. A name's historical meaning does not determine its bearer's gender, background, or personality, and the packet does not identify a particular bearer. Sources: [name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/bonnie), [Scots dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd00063617).
